verses.1: The song of praise to the LORD, in my times of trouble, I cried out to Him, and He answered me.
verses.2: May the LORD save my soul from the snare of deceitfulness, from the lies of hypocrisy.
verses.3: What will you be given, and what will be added to you as a reward?
verses.4: Half of the rulers are replaced by those who are capable of ruling.
verses.5: Oh, why have I lived in a place where I have to sleep with my tent.
verses.6: The rabbi who lived there brought peace to my soul with his kindness.
verses.7: I am at peace, and it is those who speak of war who are in trouble.
